title: ACA House
team: Andrea Cutroni, Cristian Tolu, Alessio De Luca
program: University of Rome Tor Vergata — Architectural Design
description: A single-family house formed by the intersection of an ellipse and a rectangle, inspired by Richard Meier's Shamberg House.
body: A two-storey single-family house inspired by Richard Meier's Shamberg House, with a plan generated from the intersection of the extrusion of an ellipse and a rectangle. The elliptical volume carries a large glass façade that opens the main living spaces to the site.
Designed in AutoCAD, Revit and Enscape, covering plans, sections and all four elevations.

sections.title: Geometry
body: The plan comes from a single move: extrude an ellipse, extrude a rectangle, and intersect them. The elliptical volume takes the glazed façade and the living spaces; the rectangle holds everything that wants a straight wall.

scenes.title: Volumes
scenes.caption: The two extrusions and their intersection — the operation the whole plan derives from.

scenes.title: Axonometric
scenes.caption: The house in wireframe, both floors read at once against the intersecting geometry.

sections.title: Plans
body: Ground and first floor. The curved edge carries the main living spaces toward the glass façade, with the rectangular wing taking service and circulation.

sections.title: Sections
body: Two sections cut through the intersection, showing the double-height space behind the glazing and how the two volumes meet in level.

sections.title: Elevations
body: All four elevations — the great elliptical glazing facing the pool to the west, a far more closed north front against the harsher weather, and to the east a rectangle decomposed into glazed modules.

sections.title: Views
body: The house in its landscape, and the interior behind the curved glass façade.

scenes.title: Exterior
scenes.caption: The elliptical volume and its glazing seen across the garden, with the rectangular wing behind.

scenes.title: Living Space
scenes.caption: Inside the curved façade, where the glazing follows the ellipse around the living space.

scenes.title: Double Height
scenes.caption: The double-height volume, lit along its full length by the curved glass wall.
